referral.reason_text: Rectal bleeding 3 months, on apixaban. Please advise whether to continue it.

deciding.fast_track_met: FIT is exactly 10, at the cut-off, with rectal bleeding and a low Hb of 112. The criteria are likely met, but the FIT sits right on the boundary and was collected after the referral date.
deciding.vetting_outcome: Rectal bleeding with FIT 10, anaemia and pallor is confirmed by the record as urgent, so an expedited slot is warranted.
deciding.first_contact: The referrer asks only whether to continue apixaban, a question that can be answered in writing, so an advice letter fits the stated query.
deciding.clinical_urgency: Unexplained bleeding with Hb 112 and FIT 10 supports level 2. Four comorbidities and anaemia make level 3 plausible, but the course is stable with no rapid decline.
deciding.record_agreement: The checklist ticks weight loss while weight_change_kg is 0, which is one material mismatch. The FIT collection date after the sent date adds some doubt.
